# SIGNALHAUS

> SIGNALHAUS is a Melbourne-based specialist growth company and marketing studio for commercial property professionals, owner-led businesses, and healthcare and allied-health practices. We combine positioning, digital marketing, AI visibility and conversion systems into clearly defined products with transparent pricing and measurable performance.

Melbourne, Australia. Contact: team@signalhaus.au · https://www.signalhaus.au

## Who we work with

- Commercial property professionals — agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers, specialist consultants
- Owner-led businesses — established professional and specialist firms proof before they commit
- Healthcare and allied health practices — multi-practitioner clinics and wellness practices

One shared condition: the buyer must need to see real clients and real outcomes before committing.

## Products and published prices (AUD, + GST)

Every price and delivery time below is published. Nothing is quoted on request and no client gets a different number.

- The Proof Audit — $3,000, 2 weeks. Optional; credits in full against any engagement within 90 days. Marketing scored 0-4 with evidence, baseline measured, three fixes ranked.
- SIGNAL / the position — $14,000, 4 weeks. Positioning and message architecture $6,500 · fee strategy $4,000 · objection playbook $3,500. Options: written personas $1,800, competitive map $1,900.
- / HAUS the system — from $38,000, 8-10 weeks. Brand identity and brand book $9,500 · website to 8 pages $16,500 (extra pages $850 each) · proposal and presentation system $6,500 · enquiry response and CRM setup $5,500.
- MOMENTUM the monthly engine — Directed $4,200/mo · Shared $7,400/mo · Held $13,500/mo. Six-month minimum, then monthly.
- Monthly services a la carte — SEO and local search $1,800 · Google and Meta ads managed $2,200 (to $15k/mo of client spend, billed direct) · AI search visibility $1,400 · editorial content and case studies $2,600 · practitioner video $2,400 · LinkedIn and key-account outreach $1,600 · email nurture and CRM $1,500 · referral partner system $1,200 · reviews and reputation $1,000. The menu is capped at MOMENTUM / Held, $13,500/mo.
- Add-ons — case study $1,800 · campaign sprint $7,500 · vertical sales edition $6,500 · pitch and tender support $1,900 · art-direction day $2,200 · strategy session $600.

## How we work

- Published prices and published scope for every product.
- One agreed commercial number per engagement, reviewed at 90 days.
- Every source file, token and governance model transfers to the client at completion, by contract.
- Claims are named, dated, sourced and caveated. Unverified client quotes are labelled as samples until real ones replace them.
